title: Observability Assistant describes both resumable threads and a limit on accessible history
problem: The feature table and context limitations give different expectations about access to earlier chat interactions.

audiences: Operators using the AI Assistant and AI troubleshooting
exclusions: Tenant-specific availability, authorization and actual data retention were outside the source review.

impact.consequence: The reader cannot determine from this page which earlier threads can be recovered.

scopeComparison: Both passages describe access to prior interactions in the same product guide.
